issues.title: Filter changes (store tab and role details)
issues.body:
1. When we remember our filters, we need to remember which tab they relate to.   

Steps to reproduce:
* log in as blue player
* leave the `Own forces` filters empty
* set a `Type` filter for `Other Forces`
* refresh the page.  See the filter is applied to own forces

I suspect we need to introduce multiple `filter` cookies, that include the name of the tab.  From within the `PlanningAssets` component, the `opFor` boolean flag can be used to determine if it is the `Own Forces` or `Other Forces` tab.

2.  When we remember Support Panel preferences, remember the role they related to.

Steps to reproduce:
* log in as `Adjudicator 1`
* select `Adjudiction` tab
* switch to `Blue` user
* note the app opens with the `Adjudication` tab open - which should not happen
